methodology_note: Mirrors the v4.5 mandate's own negative-control discipline (the exact rigor that caught that mandate's failure): every mechanism capable of preventing or altering a candidate's fate is checked against ALL 187 real v4.4 confirmations, not a hand-picked sample. A registry-size improvement or a lower average candidate lifetime is NEVER treated as evidence of safety by itself. The raw coarse start-time-matched 'lost: 46' figure was NOT taken at face value -- each of the 46 was individually re-investigated via full window-overlap of vNext's own per-structure lifetime (including continued_from_id merge-chain following) against the v4.4 episode's full window, using an unbounded structure history (12813 records) captured by polling the bounded _macro_history deque every bar before eviction.

per_episode_classification.method: for each of the 46, checked whether ANY vNext structure whose OWN [start_ts, end_ts] window overlaps the v4.4 episode's FULL window (not just the midpoint) -- or any descendant reached via its continued_from_id chain -- ever reached reached_confirmed=True

lost_confirmation_analysis.classification_summary: 89.1% (41/46) of the raw 'lost' figure is a matching-methodology artifact, not a real loss. Refined true lost-confirmation rate: 5/187 = 2.7%, or 4/187 = 2.14% excluding the one case (id=741) that involves only the pre-existing, non-vNext-specific ZONES_DEGENERATE check.

confirmation_delay_change.interpretation: 45/48 (93.75%) resolve faster under vNext. The single most extreme outlier (v4.4 id=86, 253.98d, matched to a 0.15d vNext structure) is almost certainly a matching-methodology artifact of the same kind quantified in lost_confirmation_analysis above -- a 254-day v4.4 confirmation is far more plausibly represented under vNext by a SEQUENCE of merged/superseded structures than by a single coincidentally nearby-starting one. Excluding that outlier, remaining deltas cluster in the 1-14 day range, directionally consistent with the mechanistic explanation in new_confirmation_inflation_check below (independent candidates reach their own T2/T3 evidence sooner, uncontaminated by an unrelated structure's absorbed price action) rather than with truncation.

duration_distribution_investigation.resolution_method: re-measured directly from each of the 4092 genuinely-confirmed structures' OWN [start_ts, end_ts] lifetime (bypassing canonical-selection churn entirely), using the same unbounded structure history as the lost-episode investigation

duration_distribution_investigation.conclusion: the alarming canonical-transition-based duration statistic is fully explained as measurement artifact from canonical-selection churn between already-confirmed candidates, NOT evidence of gate weakening or confirmation inflation. vNext's genuinely faster median (13.25h vs v4.4's 22h) is mechanistically explicable: an independent candidate is not contaminated by price action a single shared slot would have absorbed into an unrelated structure, so it reaches its own T2/T3 evidence sooner.

Merge shows zero involvement in any genuine loss. The 'changed' bucket skews toward faster (not truncated) resolution once the matching artifact is accounted for. The new-confirmation duration distribution is healthy once measured per-structure rather than via the inflated canonical-transition tracker. Per mandate section 21, this negative control does NOT show the destructive pattern that closed the v4.5 mandate, and supports proceeding to a positive verdict in research report section 14.
